notes.title: Classic Sierra Bundle, Now Available!
notes.content:
The Classic Sierra Bundle from Activision is now available on Steam. Pick up 20 classic titles in complete-the-set bundle, on special discount now!*

The bundle includes a variety of great games, from old-school third person RPGs like Arcanum to classic Strategy masterpieces like Zeus + Poseidon. Get the individual games at 40% off, or save big on the entire bundle.

*Offer ends January 2, 2017
